final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes (3/3), including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes accented characters (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before calling `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`, because its header and `vendor/README.md` say not to edit vendored code by hand.

The same vendored `slugify` also builds product URLs in `src/shop/product-url.js`, so product names with accents will still lose those letters. I left that alone because you asked about blog posts. The same wrapper fix would work there if you want it.
